name: my-team
description: atmux team — edit this to match your project
_comment_singleSession: Default false (2026-04-30 reversal of ADR-026) — cage isolation per ADR-018 is the safe path; singleSession opts out of it on the daily-driver socket and reintroduces the side-channel pollution class (cage-prefix leak, cross-socket spawn, partial-rename mess). Launcher sessions (atmux_<team> created by atmux doctor --fix) preserve the at-a-glance benefit while keeping isolation. Set true ONLY for non-human-driven teams or detached observer setups (declared escape hatch).
_comment_driverTui: TUI to auto-spawn in the cage's driver window on `atmux start`. Defaults to claude. Set null to skip auto-spawn (operator runs whatever they want manually after attach).

tuiCommands._comment: Per-team TUI launch aliases. If set, the prefix here replaces the built-in default for that TUI type. atmux appends --model <model> unless the prefix already has one. Example: "claude": "claude --plugin-dir=$HOME/work/journals/.sb/claude-skills"

_comment_discord: Optional. webhook = pings target (env ATMUX_DISCORD_WEBHOOK overrides). color = hex override for embed (auto-derived from team-name hash if absent, see ADR-019 §16-color palette). emoji = leading title glyph (defaults to 🤖). Strip any field to fall back to defaults.
